boat_access_islands_pine_island_gasparil.rule: Useppa, Cabbage Key, North and Upper Captiva (boat-access islands carrying Captiva's 33924), Pine Island (Bokeelia 33922, St. James City 33956, Pineland 33945) and Boca Grande / Gasparilla Island are refused; a premises whose own name or street names one is refused even under an admitted code; Matlacha shares 33993 with Cape Coral and is covered whole under its own municipality.

naples_and_collier_county.rule: Naples, North Naples, Marco Island, Immokalee and every Collier County premises are refused (FUTURE_STANDALONE naples-fl); Bonita Springs and Estero are Lee County and admitted by their own codes. A 'Naples North' marketing name on a Bonita Springs premises admits it by its own Lee code and publishes Bonita Springs, never Naples.

fort_myers_ruling.classification: The Fort Myers / Cape Coral market is admitted as Lee County's traveller lodging -- Downtown / River District, Colonial Boulevard & Cleveland Avenue, Daniels Parkway & Six Mile Cypress, RSW / Gateway and East Fort Myers / I-75 CORE; Cape Coral, Fort Myers Beach, South Fort Myers / Iona, Sanibel, Estero and Bonita Springs STRONG CORRIDOR; North Fort Myers, Lehigh Acres / Alva and Captiva FRINGE. Naples, Marco Island, Everglades City, Punta Gorda, Port Charlotte, Englewood / Boca Grande, Pine Island, LaBelle, Sarasota, Bradenton and Venice are OUTSIDE.
fort_myers_ruling.a_marketing_phrase_admits_nothing: 'Fort Myers', 'Fort Myers Area', 'Southwest Florida', 'Beaches of Fort Myers & Sanibel', 'RSW Airport', 'Naples-Fort Myers' and 'Naples North' are marketing. The property's own postal code decides membership and its municipality.
fort_myers_ruling.actual_location: Decided by the property's own postal code on its own page; the county and the municipality by that code; a State licence naming Collier, Charlotte or Hendry County refuses.
fort_myers_ruling.drive_market_relationship: Downtown, the US-41 / Colonial / Daniels hotel rows, the airport, Cape Coral, the beach and the islands, Estero and Bonita Springs are where Fort Myers travellers sleep; Naples, Marco Island, Punta Gorda and Sarasota are trips of their own.
fort_myers_ruling.traveller_intent: Leisure (Fort Myers Beach, Sanibel and Captiva, the Edison and Ford Winter Estates), spring training (JetBlue Park, Hammond Stadium), RSW airport, Florida Gulf Coast University, medical (Lee Health, Gulf Coast Medical Center, Golisano Children's), Hertz Arena and Coconut Point demand is this market's intent.
fort_myers_ruling.metro_continuity: Continuous development runs along US-41 and I-75 from North Fort Myers through Fort Myers, Estero and Bonita Springs to the Collier County line at Bonita Beach Road; this registry stops there.
fort_myers_ruling.corridor_support: Every admitted edge code is in a named corridor so its count is visible and a founder can move it on the record.
fort_myers_ruling.preserved_for: FUTURE_STANDALONE naples-fl, marco-island-fl, everglades-city-fl, punta-gorda-port-charlotte-fl, englewood-boca-grande-fl, sarasota-fl, bradenton-fl and venice-fl.

lee.ruling: ADMITTED, MUNICIPALITIES PRESERVED. Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Fort Myers Beach, Sanibel, Estero and Bonita Springs are admitted with Gateway / RSW, South Fort Myers / Iona and East Fort Myers; North Fort Myers, Lehigh Acres / Alva and Captiva at FRINGE. Pine Island (Bokeelia, St. James City, Pineland), Cabbage Key, Useppa, North Captiva and Boca Grande (Gasparilla Island) are refused.

collier.ruling: REFUSED WHOLE. Naples, North Naples, Marco Island, Everglades City, Immokalee and Ave Maria are future standalone markets. A premises the State licenses in Collier County is refused even where its mailing label reads Bonita Springs (34134 north of the county line) -- COUNTY_REFUSALS.

charlotte.ruling: REFUSED WHOLE. Punta Gorda, Port Charlotte, Englewood, Placida and Rotonda are future standalone markets; Boca Grande (Lee County, Gasparilla Island) is refused with them.

hendry / glades / sarasota / manatee / d.ruling: REFUSED. LaBelle, Clewiston, Sarasota, Bradenton, Venice, North Port and Arcadia are not absorbed.
